title: RAMA-NOTEBOOK: machine-verified experimental mathematics
description: Four short number-theory/combinatorics notes with Lean 4 + Mathlib formalizations: the permanent of the GCD matrix (congruences, 2-adic valuation, growth), the expected characteristic polynomial of random cycle lifts, coefficient stability of d-matching polynomials, and a partition self-divisibility note; plus a methodology note on the computation-to-formal-proof pipeline.
